projects.title: Project settings

creators.label: Who can create projects
creators.hint: Controls who may start new projects in this company.

defaultStages.label: Default stages for new projects
defaultStages.hint: Copied into every new project. Existing projects are not affected.

createRequirements.label: Required on create
createRequirements.hint: These rules apply only when creating a project. Existing projects stay editable even if they are incomplete.

approval.label: Default completion approval
approval.hint: Copied onto new projects. Existing projects retain their current approval policy.

reminders.label: Deadline reminders
reminders.enabled: Send inbox reminders before the deadline
reminders.digest: Daily overdue digest for the project manager
reminders.hint: Reminders apply to eligible current tasks according to their dates and status; they do not create tasks or dates.

errors.sequence: Sequence must be a whole number.

projects.scopeHint: Policies, defaults, and shared reference data for this company. Existing projects change only where a section says they do.

creation.title: Project creation policy
creation.hint: Controls who can start a project and what must be entered at creation. These rules do not update existing projects.

defaults.title: Defaults for new projects
defaults.hint: Stages and task completion approval are copied into a project when it is created. Changing them does not update existing projects.
